body.heading: Build your spaceship
paragraphs: Your adult cuts a door in the box. Draw buttons, dials, and a window full of stars on the inside.
Put a cushion inside for the pilot's seat. Every spaceship needs a very serious control panel.

body.heading: Fly the mission
paragraphs: Climb in, close your eyes, and count down together: five, four, three, two, one... blast off!
Describe what you can see: the moon, a comet, a planet made of cheese. The crew decides where to land.

takeaway: A box plus a countdown can fly you all the way to the moon.
safetyNotes: An adult cuts any doors or flaps, checks the box is clean and dry, and the box is never closed with anyone inside.
screenFreeExtension: Draw a star map of where your spaceship went and keep it by your bed.
